name: backwards-fill
about: Re-check: a drum fill reversed into a copy.

steps.say: make a 1 bar beat with a snare fill at the end
make pattern 2 the same beat but backwards

name: crackle-2
about: Re-check: vinyl crackle from the crackle voice.

steps.say: make a lofi hip hop beat
add vinyl crackle under it

name: no-the-other-way
about: A correction that reverses the last change.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass
make the bass brighter
no, the other way, darker than it was at first

name: teach-after-doing
about: A request to learn the steps of something already done.

steps.say: put a reverb on the chords on track 7
now tell me exactly how to do that myself on my op-xy, key by key

name: slang-typos
about: A request full of typos and slang.

steps.say: yo mak me a hard bet wit sum heavy 808 bass n hats rollin
fais-moi un beat house avec une basse, s'il te plaît

name: remember-tempo
about: A preference kept in memory and used later.

steps.say: remember that I always work at 92 bpm
make me a beat

name: what-can-you-do
about: A question about the agent itself.

steps.say: what can you do?

name: load-from-device
about: A device request with nothing connected.

steps.say: load the project that's on my op-xy right now

name: pluck-sound
about: A preset choice for a track.

steps.say: put a chord progression on track 3
change track 3's sound to a pluck
put Am F C G on track 4 and arpeggiate them
make the arp go down instead of up, and faster

name: what-knob
about: A question about the screen the user is on.

steps.say: what do the knobs do on this page?
write something in the style of a Bach two-part invention on tracks 4 and 5

name: bar-pipes-notes
about: Re-check: notes written with | between bars.

steps.say: write a 2 bar bassline on track 3, give me the notes bar by bar

name: four-songs
about: A request past what fits one answer.

steps.say: make me four different songs, each with an intro, verse and chorus

name: drums-only-in-chorus
about: A part present in only one section.

steps.say: make a song with a verse and a chorus
take the drums out of the verse, keep them in the chorus
